logic.map_show: IDA pseudocode 0045/00455138.c partitions live RoomZones using HasBeenVisited, then collects source objects and creates the map camera.
logic.zone_geometry: CanonicalModuleV1::init_post in port/level-world/canonical_level_config_module_v1.cpp calls generated RoomZone construction only after inherited InitPost/visual/floor gates and a successful type-11 spawn. The bounds come from the same transformed visual root box. source_map_decoded_room_zone_v1.cpp calculates that candidate from actual FixedMap BRES mesh AABBs and cached scene matrices.
logic.containment: CanonicalRoomZoneV3::source_has_inside_v104 and DecodedRoomZoneV1::has_inside implement inclusive X/Y bounds and intentionally ignore Z.
logic.visitation: CanonicalRoomZoneV3::source_update_v104 snapshots the zone bounds, requires six current camera planes, handles activation/deactivation and visible-room service gates, and only then reads the local-player position. It sets the same associated Module::visited3fc byte when a present local player is inside. source_has_been_visited_v104 reads that exact backlink byte; a moduleless source RoomZone reports visited=true.
logic.same_session_position: runtime_source_map_actor_markers_v1.cpp validates the current CombatSession local-player ActorState, world/player trait, finite transform, update serial, and retained actor binding lease before exposing the family-3 position. The new producer reuses that check and revalidates Session/world/actor/update serial/lease before publishing zone joins.

evidence.expected_behavior: For the ordered module occurrences in a decoded current level, preserve the exact decoded transformed-root bounds and calculate current player containment with source inclusive-XY semantics. Keep source visitation unknown until the caller supplies the same live Module/RoomZone state; containment alone must not mark a map room visited.

implementation.api: source_map_current_session_room_zones_v1(FixedMapV1::Borrow, const CombatSession&, vector<SessionRoomZoneV1>&, error) decodes actual ordered FixedMap module roots and joins the live current-session player transform; source_map_bind_session_to_decoded_room_zones_v1 accepts already-retained decoded records for shared-decode callsites.
implementation.output: Each output record carries the original decoded zone lease/order/name/bounds, same-session player id/position and binding lease, exact current containment, and visited=nullopt. It is not accepted as a RoomZoneV1 for Map.Show until a same-live Module visitation provider resolves the actual RoomZone backlink.

uncertainties: FixedMapV1 has no proof that Module construction passed its production gates, that ObjectManager generated a type-11 RoomZone, or that the RoomZone belongs to the current Level +36 list.

CombatSession does not publish a same-owner RoomZone/Module backlink, camera-plane test, visible-room activation state, or Module::visited3fc cell. The producer therefore cannot advance source visitation. The exact source trigger needs those runtime providers, in addition to this current player position.
No production MapSheet collector/callsite currently supplies these providers; no main/CMake edits or UI capture are included.
